scope_review.implementation: One additive 27-line inherent Ui::command_scope method plus one module declaration. Existing focus_scope(Normal) encloses actual render; existing scoped typed publication uses empty flags after callback. Existing return value, Ui clipping/layer/focus and stable owner/table behavior retained.
scope_review.runtime_changes: No runtime dispatch, keymap, focus resolver, global Capture/Bubble, application, geometry or painting implementation changed. No unsafe code or new ownership/concurrency/error-handling concern found.
scope_review.input_safety: Existing top-layer/focused-descendant matching, depth ordering and before/after callback scope/focus revalidation remain authoritative. The method adds no focusable control, hit region, cursor or pixels. Registration suppression already excludes inert/reference publication.
scope_review.configuration: No flags API or new implicit disabled-state system. Static table/empty slice selects available commands, and existing component remap/remove resolves effective keys. Public consumer uses borrowed real components and only public facade API; no author imports or ordinary coordinate calculation.
scope_review.measurement: Wrapper is a draw/publication adapter only; does not call update, measure, or domain handler. Existing FnOnce body executes within shared scope guard.
